args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions. Rollback confirmed rolled_out across all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: Reviewed the deployment history and found v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1 was the unhealthy latest deploy).

3. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions — confirmed `rolled_out` across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, describing the health-check failures and the rollback action taken. On-call has been paged.
